components.html: The wardrobeHow to order

narrative.overview: The wardrobe is the primary experience: generous ivory space, peach studio light, a silver clothing rail and real garment models. Editorial serif headlines pair with a quiet sans-serif interface. No glass, purple, video, stock imagery or invented product claims.
dos: Do keep the garment scene primary and supporting interface quiet.
Do provide gesture alternatives and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't add glass, purple, video, stock imagery or invented product claims.
